context: A uni intern interviews a manager about communication protocols
purpose: Teach: 郵送/口頭/卸売/呼び出し/要旨/契機/有意義/増殖

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本日はお時間いただき、有意義なお話が伺えれば嬉しいです。
lines.en: Thank you for your time today; I hope to have a meaningful discussion.
lines.style: Polite intern opening, slightly nervous but earnest tone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: こちらこそ。早速だけど、社内の連絡って基本は口頭でやり取りしてるの。
lines.en: Likewise. To get right to it, internal communication is mostly handled verbally.
lines.style: Friendly senior, businesslike but warm, gets to the point.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。正式な書類なんかは郵送で取引先に送るんでしょうか。
lines.en: I see. Are formal documents mailed out to clients then?
lines.style: Curious follow-up question, taking mental notes politely.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うん、特に卸売の契約書はまだ紙で郵送が多いかな。電子化は進んでるけどね。
lines.en: Yes, wholesale contracts especially are still mostly mailed on paper.
lines.style: Explaining workflow casually, with a small qualifier.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 緊急の時はどうされてますか。やっぱり電話の呼び出しですか。
lines.en: And in urgent cases, do you rely on phone calls?
lines.style: Pressing for practical detail, intern-style inquisitiveness.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: そうそう、呼び出し音が鳴ったら全員ピリッとするよ。要旨だけメモして即対応ね。
lines.en: Exactly, when the ring tone sounds we all snap to attention; just jot down the gist and respond fast.
lines.style: Light humor mixed with professional advice, vivid description.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最近は情報がどんどん増殖していくので、整理の仕方も難しそうですね。
lines.en: Information just keeps multiplying lately, so organizing it sounds tough.
lines.style: Reflective comment in casual spoken register, intern thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: そこに気づけたのが今日の大事な契機だね。学生のうちから意識できると強いよ。
lines.en: Noticing that is an important turning point today; awareness early on is powerful.
lines.style: Mentor-like closing remark, encouraging and slightly proud.
